objective: understand rental ads and lease terms
heading: Renting an apartment

phrases.en: I saw an ad for an apartment for rent in Tel Aviv.

phrases.he: שכר הדירה כולל ועד בית וארנונה.
phrases.en: The rent includes building maintenance fees and municipal tax.

phrases.he: החוזה הוא לשנה עם אופציה להארכה.
phrases.en: The contract is for a year with an option to extend.
The apartment is on the third floor without an elevator.

phrases.he: המשכיר ביקש ערבות של שלושה חודשים.
phrases.en: The landlord asked for a guarantee of three months.

sentences.he: ראיתי מודעה לדירה להשכרה בתל אביב.
sentences.en: I saw an ad for an apartment for rent in Tel Aviv.
alt: I saw an advertisement for a rental apartment in Tel Aviv.

sentences.he: שכר הדירה כולל ועד בית וארנונה.
sentences.en: The rent includes building maintenance fees and municipal tax.
alt: The rent includes building fees and property tax.

sentences.he: הדירה בקומה שלישית בלי מעלית.
sentences.en: The apartment is on the third floor without an elevator.
alt: The flat is on the third floor with no lift.

sentences.he: כמה חדרים יש בדירה?
sentences.en: How many rooms are there in the apartment?
alt: How many rooms does the apartment have?

sentences.he: המשכיר ביקש ערבות של שלושה חודשים.
sentences.en: The landlord asked for a guarantee of three months.
alt: The landlord requested a three-month security deposit.

sentences.he: החוזה הוא לשנה עם אופציה להארכה.
sentences.en: The contract is for a year with an option to extend.
alt: The lease is for one year with an extension option.

sentences.he: יש מרפסת גדולה עם נוף לים.
sentences.en: There is a large balcony with a sea view.
alt: There's a big balcony overlooking the sea.

sentences.he: הדירה מרוהטת או ריקה?
sentences.en: Is the apartment furnished or empty?
alt: Is the flat furnished or unfurnished?

sentences.he: אנחנו מחפשים דירה עם חניה ומיזוג.
sentences.en: We are looking for an apartment with parking and air conditioning.
alt: We're looking for a flat with parking and AC.

sentences.he: הארנונה בתל אביב יקרה מאוד.
sentences.en: The municipal tax in Tel Aviv is very expensive.
alt: Property tax in Tel Aviv is very high.

sentences.he: השוכר צריך לשלם את הוועד בית כל חודש.
sentences.en: The tenant needs to pay the building maintenance fee every month.
alt: The renter must pay the building fees each month.

sentences.he: מתי מועד הפינוי של הדירה?
sentences.en: When is the apartment's move-out date?
alt: When is the evacuation date of the apartment?

sentences.he: הריהוט בדירה ישן אבל במצב טוב.
sentences.en: The furniture in the apartment is old but in good condition.
alt: The apartment's furniture is old but in good shape.

sentences.he: חתמנו על חוזה שכירות לשנתיים.
sentences.en: We signed a rental contract for two years.
alt: We signed a two-year lease.

sentences.he: הדירה נמצאת בקומה הראשונה ויש לה גינה.
sentences.en: The apartment is on the first floor and it has a garden.
alt: The flat is on the ground floor and has a garden.

sentences.he: המעלית בבניין לא עובדת כבר שבוע.
sentences.en: The elevator in the building hasn't been working for a week.
alt: The building's elevator has been broken for a week.

sentences.he: שכר הדירה עלה באלף שקלים בשנה האחרונה.
sentences.en: The rent went up by a thousand shekels in the last year.
alt: The rent increased by one thousand shekels last year.

sentences.he: יש שלושה חדרים, סלון ומטבח גדול.
sentences.en: There are three rooms, a living room, and a large kitchen.
alt: There are three bedrooms, a lounge, and a big kitchen.

sentences.he: המודעה אומרת שהדירה מתאימה לזוג.
sentences.en: The ad says the apartment is suitable for a couple.
alt: The advertisement says the flat is suitable for a couple.

sentences.he: אני צריך לתת ערבות בנקאית למשכיר.
sentences.en: I need to give a bank guarantee to the landlord.
alt: I need to provide a bank guarantee to the landlord.

sentences.he: הדירה בלי מיזוג וזה בעיה בקיץ.
sentences.en: The apartment has no air conditioning and that's a problem in summer.
alt: The flat doesn't have AC and that is a problem in summer.

sentences.he: המשכיר אמר שצריך לפנות את הדירה עד סוף החודש.
sentences.en: The landlord said the apartment needs to be vacated by the end of the month.
alt: The landlord said you need to move out by the end of the month.

sentences.he: חניה בבניין עולה שלוש מאות שקלים בחודש.
sentences.en: Parking in the building costs three hundred shekels a month.
alt: Building parking costs 300 shekels per month.

sentences.he: קראתי את החוזה ויש כמה סעיפים שאני לא מבין.
sentences.en: I read the contract and there are some clauses I don't understand.
alt: I read the lease and there are a few clauses I don't understand.

sentences.he: הקומה העליונה חמה בקיץ בלי מיזוג.
sentences.en: The top floor is hot in summer without air conditioning.
alt: The upper floor is hot in summer without AC.

sentences.he: השוכרים הקודמים השאירו את הדירה במצב גרוע.
sentences.en: The previous tenants left the apartment in bad condition.
alt: The former renters left the flat in poor shape.

sentences.he: הדירה כוללת שני חדרי שינה ומרפסת.
sentences.en: The apartment includes two bedrooms and a balcony.
alt: The flat has two bedrooms and a balcony.

sentences.he: אפשר לראות את הדירה ביום שישי?
sentences.en: Can I see the apartment on Friday?
alt: Is it possible to see the flat on Friday?

sentences.he: השכירות משולמת בהעברה בנקאית כל ראשון לחודש.
sentences.en: The rent is paid by bank transfer on the first of every month.
alt: Rent is paid via bank transfer every first of the month.

sentences.he: הבניין ישן אבל יש בו מעלית חדשה.
sentences.en: The building is old but it has a new elevator.
alt: The building is old but has a new lift.

sentences.he: שמעתי שהארנונה עולה כל שנה.
sentences.en: I heard that the municipal tax goes up every year.
alt: I heard property tax increases every year.

sentences.he: הדירה מרוהטת עם כל מה שצריך.
sentences.en: The apartment is furnished with everything you need.
alt: The flat is furnished with all you need.

sentences.he: המשכיר הסכים להוריד את שכר הדירה.
sentences.en: The landlord agreed to lower the rent.
alt: The landlord agreed to reduce the rent.

sentences.he: צריך לשלם ועד בית גם אם גרים בקומת קרקע.
sentences.en: You need to pay building fees even if you live on the ground floor.
alt: Building maintenance fees must be paid even on the ground floor.

sentences.he: ביקשנו מהמשכיר לתקן את המיזוג לפני הכניסה.
sentences.en: We asked the landlord to fix the air conditioning before moving in.
alt: We requested the landlord to repair the AC before entry.

sentences.he: הדירה בקומה חמישית עם נוף יפה למרפסת.
sentences.en: The apartment is on the fifth floor with a nice view from the balcony.

sentences.he: כמה עולה הארנונה לדירת שלושה חדרים?
sentences.en: How much is the municipal tax for a three-room apartment?
alt: How much does the property tax cost for a three-bedroom apartment?

sentences.he: בחוזה כתוב שאסור להחזיק חיות מחמד.
sentences.en: The contract says it's forbidden to have pets.
alt: The lease states that pets are not allowed.

sentences.he: מצאנו דירה עם חניה, מעלית ומרפסת.
sentences.en: We found an apartment with parking, an elevator, and a balcony.
alt: We found a flat with parking, a lift, and a balcony.

sentences.he: הפינוי צריך להיות חודש לפני סוף החוזה.
sentences.en: The move-out needs to be a month before the contract ends.
alt: Vacating needs to happen a month before the end of the lease.

sentences.he: השוכר אחראי לתקן נזקים קטנים בדירה.
sentences.en: The tenant is responsible for fixing minor damages in the apartment.
alt: The renter is responsible for repairing small damages in the flat.

sentences.he: המודעה כתובה בעברית ובערבית.
sentences.en: The ad is written in Hebrew and in Arabic.
alt: The advertisement is in Hebrew and Arabic.

sentences.he: אנחנו גרים בשכירות כבר חמש שנים.
sentences.en: We have been renting for five years already.
alt: We've been living in a rental for five years.

sentences.he: הערבות תוחזר בסוף תקופת השכירות.
sentences.en: The guarantee will be returned at the end of the rental period.
alt: The security deposit will be refunded at the end of the lease.

tips:
**Rental vocabulary in Israel**

Renting in Israel has specific terms:
- שכר דירה = rent (lit. 'apartment wage')
- ועד בית = building maintenance fee (lit. 'house committee')
- ארנונה = municipal/property tax (paid to the city)

**Lease terms**: חוזה שכירות (rental contract/lease), ערבות (security deposit/guarantee), פינוי (move-out/vacating), משכיר (landlord), שוכר (tenant).

**Floor numbering**: In Israel, קומת קרקע (ground floor) is floor 0, and קומה ראשונה (first floor) is one flight up, like the European system.
